widget.name: Transfer List
widget.description: A Mendix widget to transfer objects from one list to another

property.caption: Left data source
property.description: Data source for the left panel items

property.caption: Left panel content
property.description: Content template for each left panel item

property.caption: Left panel label
property.description: Label shown above the left panel

property.caption: Right data source
property.description: Data source for the right panel items

property.caption: Right panel content
property.description: Content template for each right panel item

property.caption: Right panel label
property.description: Label shown above the right panel

property.caption: Show item count
property.description: Show the number of items in each panel header.

property.caption: Panel height mode
property.description: Fixed: set an explicit height. Fill: expand to fill the parent container.

property.caption: Panel height
property.description: Numeric height value (fixed mode only)

property.caption: Panel height unit
property.description: CSS unit for the panel height (fixed mode only)

property.caption: Panel min. height
property.description: Minimum panel body height (fill mode only). 0 = no minimum. Prevents the panel from collapsing when few items are present.

property.caption: Panel min. height unit
property.description: CSS unit for the minimum panel height (fill mode only).

property.caption: Interaction mode
property.description: How users interact with items to move them

property.caption: Move selected right icon
property.description: Icon for the Move selected to right button. Defaults to ›.

property.caption: Move selected left icon
property.description: Icon for the Move selected to left button. Defaults to ‹.

property.caption: Show move all buttons
property.description: Show buttons to move all items to either panel at once

property.caption: Move all right icon
property.description: Icon for the Move all to right button. Defaults to ».

property.caption: Move all left icon
property.description: Icon for the Move all to left button. Defaults to «.

property.caption: Add action
property.description: Action called once per item moved to the right panel. Use a nanoflow for large lists; a microflow fires one server request per item.

property.caption: Remove action
property.description: Action called once per item moved to the left panel. Use a nanoflow for large lists; a microflow fires one server request per item.

property.caption: Show left search
property.description: Show a search input above the left panel

property.caption: Left search text
property.description: Text template matched against the search query in the left panel

property.caption: Left search placeholder
property.description: Placeholder text shown in the left panel search box. Supports Mendix translations.

property.caption: Show right search
property.description: Show a search input above the right panel

property.caption: Right search text
property.description: Text template matched against the search query in the right panel

property.caption: Right search placeholder
property.description: Placeholder text shown in the right panel search box. Supports Mendix translations.
